title: Analysis of patient-specific immunoglobulin proteomes and transcriptomes by PCR cloning and mass spectrometry
protocol: Centrifuge 3 ml fresh CSF sample at 1,750 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Freeze supernatant immediately at -80°C.
Lysate cells in 350 μl RLT buffer and store until further processing at -80°C.
Isolate RNA using the RNeasy Micro Kit according to manufacturer recommendations.
Add 5 μl of carrier poly-A-RNA (4 ng/μl) to cell lysate if fewer than 5,000 cells are analyzed.
Elute RNA in 14 μl RNase-free water; final volume results in 12 μl.
Perform reverse transcription in a 20 μl RT reaction mix for 90 minutes at 37°C using the total amount of RNA from step 5.
Amplify IgG Heavy and Light chain cDNAs in independent experiments with two rounds of nested PCR in final volumes of 20 μl each.
Use 3 μl of cDNA as template for the first, outer PCRs.
Use 2 μl of PCR product from the first reaction as template for the second, inner PCR.
Run first PCR: 3 minutes at 94°C followed by 50 cycles of 30 seconds at 94°C, 30 seconds at 55°C, and 55 seconds at 72°C; then 10 minutes at 72°C.
Run second PCR: 3 minutes at 94°C followed by 50 cycles of 30 seconds at 94°C, 30 seconds at 55°C, and 45 seconds at 72°C; then 10 minutes at 72°C.
Separate PCR products by electrophoresis in 2% agarose/TBE buffer.
Isolate IgG Heavy and Light chains using the Easypure DNA Purification Kit.
Dissolve purified DNA in 12 μl EB buffer.
Insert the IgG heavy and light chains into the pCR®2.1TOPO vector using the TOPO TA Cloning Kit.
Transform One Shot® Chemically Competent E.coli according to manufacturer recommendations.
Select white colonies by blue/white screening.
Pick at least 40 white colonies per chain for further analysis.
Culture selected colonies overnight in 3 ml LB medium containing 100 μg/μl ampicillin.
Isolate plasmid DNA using QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit.
Elute plasmid DNA in 30 μl EB buffer.
Perform DNA sequencing by standard methods using the primer "M13 forward (-20)" (Invitrogen).
Wash Dynabeads® Protein G three times in 0.1M Na-acetate, 0.15 M NaCl pH 5.0.
Centrifuge CSF supernatant at 17,500 g for 5 min at 4 °C (Microcentrifuge 5417 R).
Add 200 μl of Dynabeads® Protein G bead suspension to CSF supernatant.
Shake at 300 rpm for 60 min at room temperature on a thermomixer.
Wash Dynabeads® Protein G three times in 0.1M Na-acetate/0.15 M NaCl pH 5.0.
Elute IgG in 50 μl Urea-containing Elution buffer.
Repeat elution to achieve a final volume of 100 μl.
Rehydrate 24 cm Immobiline DryStrip pH 3–10 in RH buffer overnight at room temperature according to the manufacturer's recommendations.
Load the sample directly at the cathodic end (pH=10) onto rehydrated Immobiline DryStrip using the Multiphor II Electrophoresis System.

Increase voltage for isoelectric focusing as follows: 300 V for 1 h, 600 V for 15 min, 900 V for 15 min, 1200 V for 15 min, 1500 V for 15 min, 1800 V for 15 min, 2100 V for 15 min, 2500 V for 15 min, 3000 V for 15 min, 3500 V for 15 min, 4000 V for 15 min, 4500 V for 15 min, and 5000 V for 20 h.
Fix proteins for 30 min in 12% TCA at room temperature on a slow shaker.
Wash IPG strip for 3 min in 25% methanol.
Stain IPG strip for 2 h by colloidal Roti®-Blue at room temperature on a slow shaker.
Destain overnight in 30% methanol/10% acetic acid.
Excise appropriate bands and transfer to reaction tubes.
Add 20-50 μl of 10 mM NH4HCO3 to cover the gel slice.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant.
Wash the gel piece with 20-50 μl 100% acetonitrile.
Repeat steps adding 10 mM NH4HCO3 and washing with acetonitrile.
Add 20-50 μl of 10 mM DTT in 10 mM NH4HCO3 to reduce disulfide bonds.
Incubate for 30 min at 60°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 100% acetonitrile.
Alkylation: Add 20-50 μl of 50 mM jodoacetamide in 10 mM NH4HCO3.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant.
Wash with 100% acetonitrile.
Wash with 10 mM NH4HCO3 and discard supernatant.
Wash with 100% acetonitrile.
Wash with 10 mM NH4HCO3 and discard supernatant.
Wash twice with 100% acetonitrile.
Digest IgG using 0.1 μg Trypsin in 20-50 μl 10 mM NH4HCO3.
Incubate overnight at 37°C.
Prepare MALDI-MS matrix by mixing 10mM NH4H2PO4/50% acetonitrile/0.1% TFA with α-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid in 50% acetonitrile/ 0.1% TFA.
Mix 1 μl of MALDI-MS matrix with 1 μl of sample and spot onto a well of the MALDI Steel Target.
Dry at room temperature.
Mix 1 μl of MALDI-MS matrix with 1 μl MS-CAL2 and spot onto another MALDI Steel Target well.
Dry at room temperature.
Insert the MALDI Steel Target in Bruker Ultraflex II TOF TOF Spectrometer.
Operate Mass Calibration according to manufacturer recommendations.
Measure samples for Mass Fingerprint in the "Proteomics method" mode.
Use 250–1000 shots, Laser Power 20–40%, accelerating voltage 20kV, Reflector Voltage 22.8KV, and Reflector Detector Voltage 1700–1750V.
Save and analyze MS spectra using software "Flex Analysis", with S/N (signal to noise percentage) of 1–4%.
Copy peaklist in program "Mascot Peptide Mass Fingerprint".

Use the following parameters for Mascot Search: Enzyme Trypsin, Allowed missed cleavages 1, Fixed modification Carbamidomethyl (C), Variable modifications Oxidation (M), (W), Peptide tolerance +/- 100 ppm.
For MS/MS analysis use "LIFT method" mode.
Use 250–1000 shots, Laser Power 50–90%, accelerating voltage 20kV, Reflector Detector Voltage 1700–1750V.
Save and analyze MS/MS spectra using software "Flex Analysis", with S/N (signal to noise percentage) of 1–4%.
Copy peaklist in program "Mascot MS/MS Ions Search".

Use the following parameters for Mascot Search: Enzyme Trypsin, Allowed missed cleavages 1, Fixed modification Carbamidomethyl (C), Variable modifications Oxidation (M), (W), Peptide tolerance +/- 100 ppm, Peptide charge 1+.
